messages:
marina: Heads up — customer ACME reporting admin role missing after SSO login in prod. Started after yesterday's auth-service deploy. Logs show "no role matched for user" when assertion contains admin. Anyone seen this?

sam: Saw a similar one in QA earlier. Short repro? Can you paste the (redacted) SAML assertion?

marina: Pasting redacted assertion snippet: 
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="roles">
  <saml:AttributeValue>user</saml:AttributeValue>
  <saml:AttributeValue>admin</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="external_id">acme|12345</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="email_verified">false</saml:Attribute>
```

sam: That helps. Our JIT mapping pipeline added an email_verified gating rule in the last deploy to prevent unverified emails becoming org-admins. It looks like that check runs before we honor an explicit roles[] attribute, so the explicit "admin" is getting ignored.

jordan: Wait — is that gating change from the 2026-02-18 deploy?

marina: Yes. We added the strict email_verified check to the group->role augmentation path. It didn't account for explicit role claims in the assertion.

ava: Proposed fix: treat explicit assertion roles as higher precedence than gated group augmentation. Also add an audit flag when we elevate based on assertion roles so we can track origin.

okta-bot: [info] SAML assertion received for external_id=acme|12345 from idp=acme-okta-prod at 2026-02-25T14:02:01Z

sam: I'll prepare a patch in auth-service: set attribute explicit_roles=true when roles[] present, and skip email_verified gate for explicit roles. Will open PR + tests.

devops: Also note: our audit sink currently filters role-change events by email_verified flag. We need to ensure role_assignment events are ingested even when email_verified=false. Add to backlog if not hotfixed.

security-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45 — SSO mapping caused access drift (severity: low). Assigned to @sam and @marina.

marina: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note to ACME explaining root cause and timeline. Sam, link the PR and ETA.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/482 — patch + unit tests. Will run staging deploy in ~30m.

jordan: One caution: if we always prefer assertion roles, a misconfigured IdP could escalate users. We should only trust assertion roles from trusted IdPs or when external_id/account mapping validates.

ava: Agreed. Implementation plan: 1) prefer explicit roles only if idp_trust_level >= 2 OR external_id maps to existing account; 2) emit audit.event.role_assignment with origin=(assertion|group); 3) add an integration test with a fake untrusted IdP.

marina: Timeline: hotfix to staging in 30m, smoke test with ACME test account, then prod after 2 hours if green. Notifying CS and support. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll also backfill audit logs for the last 24h window and tag affected users. Adding a migration to mark those events so we can query easily.

marina: Thanks everyone. Once prod deploy is done and audit backfill confirmed, I'll close this thread.

sam: Ping me for verification.

marina: Closing once prod is live.
